evidence.description: Spec 096's frozen pilot materials: the freeze-pinned corpus (SHA-256 5077285e8eac4b21785ca29cb151d47407f780998d85fa1eea27ef9d7e04f2dd), the E1 driver (records/eteocypriot-e1-driver.py: the R1-R3 derivation and LCCS scoring), and the filed E1 run record of 2026-11-20 (records/eteocypriot-e1-run-2026-11-20.json: the score matrix and the A2 rule's joint infeasibility on segment 6).

falsification_tests: Any of: the recomputed matrix differing from the filed run record in any cell; the exhaustive QUBO optimum differing from the ILP optimum in value; a QUBO maximizer that is infeasible (a name without exactly one segment, or a segment carrying two names); an infeasible point of the real instance with objective value at or above 0.
claims.text: The benchmark's instance and formulation are faithful to the Spec 096 pilot's scoring: the score matrix recomputed from the freeze-pinned corpus (SHA-256 5077285e8eac4b21785ca29cb151d47407f780998d85fa1eea27ef9d7e04f2dd) by the E1 driver's own derivation equals the filed E1 run record's matrix exactly, and the QUBO of spec section 3 (penalty P = 1 + the sum of all scores) attains its maximum exactly at the best feasible one-to-one assignment of that scoring, certified independently by exhaustive enumeration and by an exact ILP solve to zero MIP gap. This does not establish: that the pilot's correspondences, or any reading of any Eteocypriot text, are correct — the corpus ground truth is never an input to the instance, the formulation, or any solver.

evidence.description: The registered arm parameters and seeds (spec.md section 4), the registered synthetic-instance generator (spec.md section 5), and the filed execution script and raw outputs of the execution landing, which together make every filed classical number reproducible on tower-compute.

falsification_tests: A rerun of the filed execution script, under the registered parameters and seeds on the same instance data, producing a different certified optimum at any size, or different simulated-annealing best values (timings excepted, which are reported as measured and expected to vary).
claims.text: The classical arms' filed results are the registered procedures' actual outputs on tower-compute: the exact arm's certified optima and times, and the simulated-annealing arm's per-restart best values, optimum-reaching counts, and times, under the parameters and seeds registered in spec section 4, on the real instance and on the synthetic instances the registered generator of spec section 5 produces. This does not establish: any solver's performance on any other instance, formulation, parameter set, or machine.

evidence.description: The IBM Quantum connector doc (custom.ibm-quantum/CONNECTOR.md: the registered route and its documented authentication reality, verified 2026-10-27) and the registration-day probe of 2026-11-25 through the connector's bin/ibm_quantum_probe2.py (HTTP 401, error code 1219, on the backends and account reads), filed in the registration record.

falsification_tests: Any quantum result in this study's records not traceable to a completed job record on the connector route; any simulator result labelled or readable as hardware; any quantum number reported for a size while the arm's outcome stands NOT EXECUTED.
claims.text: The quantum arm's reported outcome is exactly what the program's IBM Quantum connector route returns: if the route authenticates and jobs complete, the best-found values filed are those of the completed job records, with simulator runs labelled SIMULATOR; if the route refuses authentication at execution as it did at the registration probe of 2026-11-25 (HTTP 401, error code 1219), the arm's outcome is NOT EXECUTED — ROUTE DEAD and no quantum number is reported for any size. This does not establish: anything about quantum hardware or QAOA capability in general — only about this program's access route and, if jobs ever run under this registration, about these instances.

evidence.description: The study's registered scope (spec.md sections 1, 6, 7): a solver benchmark whose verdicts are V-104-A and V-104-B only, over an instance built from Spec 096's pilot scoring, with the corpus ground truth never an input.

falsification_tests: Any record of this study stating a changed standing, verdict, or tally; any citing record treating this benchmark's outcomes as evidence for or against any decipherment claim, including the ICS 196 correspondences.
claims.text: This study moves no standing of any kind: no anchor standing, claim verdict, or tally in the Indus, Eteocypriot, or Meroitic programs changes by anything this study files, and its verdicts concern solvers only. This does not establish: that the alignment formulation is the right model of the Amathus bilingual — it is the Spec 096 pilot's own scoring reused as an optimization instance, nothing more.
